meta.name: Instagram
meta.source: Measured from instagram.com mobile web, logged-out public profile at 375px, light and dark (DOM computed styles); layout and tone cross-checked against the 8 official App Store screenshots of Instagram 455.0.0 (reference/screens). Native app values not measured.
not_copied: the ring colour stops as a brand gradient
meta.role_in_project: Core reference #2 for Gift Circle (Life360 is #1). Gift Circle takes Instagram's content-first canvas, photo grid, ring and sheet. Amazon gift cards are a separate texture pack, not part of this spec.

soul.one_line: A white page that gets out of the way: photo grid, one gradient ring, one blue button.
soul.lineage: 2016 flat redesign by Ian Spalter's team: black-and-white chrome so photos carry the colour.
soul.read_distance: arm's length, one thumb, scrolled fast

colors.name: violet, yellow, orange, pink, magenta sweep

families.fallback: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

scale.note: 20/700 username, 14/400 everything else, 14/600 button. 12 inferred for captions and timestamps.

treatment.case: sentence case or lowercase handles, never uppercase

space.grid: 3 equal columns, 1px gutter both ways, edge to edge, cells 3:4 (124x165 at 375)
space.rhythm: header 64px, avatar 96px (25.6% of width) at x=22, text block 14/18, icon tab row, grid
space.negative_space: tight; the grid is the density
space.safe_area: bottom tab bar of 5 icons, no labels (from screenshots)

surface.edges: buttons radius 8px; sheets rounded at top only (about 24px, inferred); avatars full circle; grid cells square-cornered
surface.elevation: none. No shadows on cards, rows or buttons. A sheet is separated by a dim scrim, not a shadow.
surface.imagery: photos fill cells edge to edge, cropped, no frames, no borders
surface.iconography: thin outline glyphs on one grid; selected state is the filled glyph, not a colour change; grid cells carry one small white glyph top-right, 8px inset: multi-photo square, play triangle or pin

signatures.how: 3 columns, 1px gutters, cells 3:4, edge to edge
signatures.when: any collection of things people posted
signatures.never: gaps over 2px, rounded cells, captions inside cells

signatures.how: circle avatar 96px at left; ring 3 to 4px with a 3px canvas gap between ring and photo; the ring is the only gradient
signatures.never: ring on non-people; ring when nothing is new (use a 1px grey ring)

signatures.how: single indigo-blue solid button 36px tall, radius 8, 14/600 white; other actions are plain text links
signatures.when: the one thing to do on this screen

signatures.how: avatar left; in the column beside it: username 20/700 + small more-dots, name 14/400, then the stats row (number bold, unit regular, dot between). Bio sits below, full width
signatures.never: stat tiles, cards, icons next to numbers

signatures.how: 3 equal-width icon-only outline glyphs (grid, reels, tagged); inactive grey, active dark with a 2px action-indigo underline; 1px hairline under the row. Native may fill the active glyph (inferred)
white sheet, small grabber, rounded top, centered 14/600 title, rows, input pinned at the bottom
signatures.never: full-screen modals for small tasks, shadows

signatures.how: one row of emoji at about 24px above the input
mine: solid action blue, white text; theirs: light grey, black text; fully rounded

weird_move.move: The story ring: a five-colour sweep (violet, yellow, orange, pink, magenta) hugging a circular avatar. It is the only gradient and the only multi-colour element in an otherwise black, white and one-blue interface.
weird_move.how: Once per row or header, around a person. About 0.5% of the screen.
weird_move.never: On buttons, headers, cards, icons or backgrounds

archetypes.purpose: who or what a circle is
archetypes.anatomy: top bar 64px (wordmark left; plain indigo text link then one solid indigo button right) / avatar 96px with ring, beside it username+name+stats / 14px bio / 3 icon tabs with hairline / 3-col grid starting right under the hairline
avatar+name row / full-width square or 4:5 photo / icon row (like, comment, share left; save right) / bold count / caption / grey timestamp
scrim / white sheet with grabber / title / rows (avatar, name+text, heart right) / reaction row / input
photo edge to edge / thin segmented progress bar top / avatar+name top / reply pill bottom
header with avatar+name / bubbles / input pill with icons

motion.entrances: sheets rise from the bottom; hearts pop and settle

voice.headline_shape: verb or plain noun: Follow, Message, Share with friends

bans: No gradient except the avatar ring.
No second action colour; one indigo-blue only.
No card containers around list rows or stats.
No coloured or tinted backgrounds on chrome; canvas is white or midnight.
No more than 3 type sizes in one frame.
No text labels on the tab row or icon rows.
No rounded corners on grid cells.

tests.check: Exactly one gradient rule per screen and it is the ring around a circular avatar
At most 3 distinct font sizes in one frame
At most one solid action-blue filled button per screen
Grid cells: gutter between 0 and 2px, no border-radius on cells
Body text is 14px with 18px line height
Largest to smallest type ratio at most 1.8:1
Action blue covers under 3% of the screen
Photos or content fill at least 30% of a collection screen
Stats: number bold, unit regular, on one row
Tab and action icons carry no text labels

gift_circle_translation.profile: an event circle page: circle avatar with ring when there is something new, name, stats row (12 people, 8 ideas, 3 claimed), 3-col grid of gift idea photos
gift_circle_translation.ring: ring on a member who added or claimed something new; 1px grey ring otherwise
gift_circle_translation.grid: gift ideas as photos, 3:4, 1px gutters; claimed ideas get a small filled glyph in the corner, never a colour wash
gift_circle_translation.sheet: claim sheet and comments use sheet-list
gift_circle_translation.action_colour: Gift Circle may map the single action colour to its own coral; keep the one-action rule
gift_circle_translation.texture_pack: Amazon gift card patterns can fill empty states and circle covers; they never sit on chrome

inferred: native app action blue (web measured #4150F7; native was #0095F6 for years)
tab bar layout from screenshots only
native fills the active tab glyph

gaps_found: Top bar: original is wordmark left + text link + indigo button; blind rebuild put the handle and a Follow button there
Stats sit in the column beside the avatar under the name, not full-width below it
Verified tick is a small sky blue badge, a deliberate second blue
Tabs: 3 not 4; inactive grey; active has a 2px indigo (not black) underline; icons are not filled on web
A 1px hairline runs between the tab row and the grid
Ring is a thin 3px band tight to a black circular photo
Spec was ambiguous on whether 96px is the photo or the outer ring box: it is the photo (96px at x=22)
reconstruction.checker_fixes: T5 now reads only gap on grid rules and ignores border-radius:0
reconstruction.note: Dark mode, sheet, chat and story screens not rebuilt

round2.result: A stranger could mistake rebuild-2 for the original at arm's length. Layout, top bar, header order, tabs, hairline, grid and tick all match.
remaining_gaps: Tab icons: original are about 24px with a 2px stroke; active is darker and bolder, inactive mid-grey
Header text block sits slightly higher: username line about 24px then name directly beneath with about 2px gap, stats 8px below
Ring is a hairline-thin 3px band; keep the 3px canvas gap
Wordmark is an image; stand-in text is acceptable
round2.not_in_spec: top-bar padding 22px left / 16px right, link 14/600, stats dot with 4px side margins, inactive icon grey about #8E8E8E, hairline about #DBDBDB (guessed by the builder and they looked right)
